add_namespace = mk_ruler

country_event = {
	id = mk_ruler.1
	title = mk_ruler.1.t
	desc = mk_ruler.1.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_sign_treaty1
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mk_has_exile_vci } }
			set_country_flag = mk_has_exile_vci
			generate_character = {
				token_base = mk_exile_vci
				name = VCI_sabirov_marat_ayratovich
				advisor = {
					slot = political_advisor
					cost = 0
					idea_token = political
					traits = { mk_ruler_vci }
					allowed = { always = yes }
				}
				advisor = {
					slot = high_command
					cost = 0
					idea_token = army
					ledger = army
					traits = { mk_ruler_vci }
					allowed = { always = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = mk_ruler.1.a
		activate_advisor = mk_exile_vci_political
		add_political_power = 25
		ai_chance = { factor = 65 }
	}
	option = {
		name = mk_ruler.1.b
		activate_advisor = mk_exile_vci_army
		army_experience = 15
		ai_chance = { factor = 35 }
	}
}
